properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory for the Ethereum dapp projects (inbox/lottery/lottery-react): hash.js feeds web3's hashing via elliptic; no in-repo call site, but it ships with the installed tree.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The repo's core signing primitive: every deploy script signs deployment transactions with mnemonic-derived secp256k1 keys. Curve is fixed by the Ethereum protocol — changeable only at ecosystem level, but the packages themselves are version-pinned here.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Browserified Node-crypto shim stack pulled in by web3 (and by crypto-browserify in lottery-react's devDependencies). The weak KDF ships whether or not the app calls it directly.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency-inventory entry: the OpenBSD bcrypt-pbkdf KDF ships in the build of inbox, lottery and lottery-react. Dev/test toolchain only (sshpk → http-signature chain); no first-party call site — the apps' own signing goes through HDWalletProvider/MetaMask.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Create React App dev-server tooling in lottery-react: node-forge mints the throwaway self-signed HTTPS cert for webpack-dev-server. Dev-only posture impact; replaceable with a Node/OpenSSL PQ-capable provider when the dev server is hardened.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Node crypto.createECDH browser polyfill, part of the crypto-browserify devDependency set in lottery-react; present in inbox's tree through web3's shims. ECDH here is a capability of the shipped tree, not an app call.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency-inventory entry: tweetnacl's Ed25519/X25519/XSalsa20-Poly1305 ship in the build of all three npm-lockfile projects. Quantum-unsafe signature scheme available but dormant; the live signing paths are HDWalletProvider (deploy scripts) and MetaMask (React app), which use secp256k1 ECDSA instead.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Part of the same Ethereum signing story: elliptic underlies secp256k1's JS implementation in the web3 tree; shipped with the installed node_modules.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl reaches this tree through web3's keystore (bcrypt-pbkdf) and http-signature (sshpk) internals; its X25519/Ed25519 capability ships with the tree.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency-inventory entry, quantum-safe KDF. Live use is indirect: @truffle/hdwallet-provider derives the BIP39 mnemonic → seed with PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512 (2048 iterations) in the three deploy.js scripts (reported as findings at those call sites). Also declared at kickstart/yarn.lock:4693 (pbkdf2@^3.0.17 — yarn format not scanned by the collector).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency-inventory entry, quantum-safe hash. Keccak-256 is the EVM-native hash: exercised at runtime by web3 for tx hashing, and on-chain by lottery/contracts/Lottery.sol:41 (keccak256 winner selection, reported as a finding). Also declared at kickstart/yarn.lock:3717 (keccak@^3.0.0 — yarn format not scanned by the collector).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: web3's V3 keystore KDF: encrypting an Ethereum private key to a keystore file runs scrypt through web3-eth-accounts. Ships in all three projects' trees.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency-inventory entry, quantum-safe hash. @noble/hashes is pulled in via web3-eth-accounts → ethereum-cryptography and ships SHA-256 in the build; reached indirectly by web3 account handling, no first-party call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency-inventory entry, quantum-safe hash. BLAKE3 ships via @noble/hashes@1.1.2 in the build; no first-party call site — available in the shipped library, not invoked by the application.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency-inventory entry, quantum-safe hash. Same @noble/hashes@1.1.2 package as the SHA-256 (ALG-928ac765) and BLAKE3 (ALG-979eccf8) records — one library, several algorithm facets.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Symmetric AEAD capability of tweetnacl shipped with the web3 tree; classical-secure, no migration pressure.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Library record for the tweetnacl@0.14.5 declaration; the Ed25519/XSalsa20-Poly1305 algorithm facets are recorded under ALG-683d5cd2. Available in the shipped build, not called by the application.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Crypto provider in the dependency inventory, quantum-safe hash library. @noble/hashes ships SHA-256 (ALG-928ac765), SHA-3 (ALG-c9ef78a4), BLAKE3 (ALG-979eccf8), scrypt and PBKDF2 in the build; reached indirectly by web3 account handling, no first-party call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Crypto provider in the dependency inventory: node-forge ships RSA, X.509/PKI and TLS primitives in the lottery-react build (CRA dev-server toolchain only — react-scripts → selfsigned self-signed dev certificates). No application call site; not part of the runtime app bundle path.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Self-signed dev certificate generation for the CRA dev server in lottery-react; dev-only, certificates never leave the developer machine. Component row for the same package is LIB-b4358cea.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X.509 certificate machinery available in the shipped node-forge package (CRA dev tooling chain); no application call site in lottery-react's src.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency-inventory entry, quantum-safe KDF. scrypt-js ships the scrypt KDF in the build (web3/truffle toolchain — keystore/scrypt account handling); also declared at kickstart/yarn.lock:5207 (scrypt-js@^3.0.0 — yarn format not scanned by the collector). No first-party call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency-inventory entry: sha.js ships the SHA-1/SHA-2 family in the build (transitive web3 toolchain); also declared at kickstart/yarn.lock:5346 (sha.js@^2.4.0 — yarn format not scanned by the collector). No first-party call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency-inventory entry: elliptic ships quantum-unsafe ECDSA signing and ECDH key agreement (secp256k1 and NIST curves) in the build of all three npm-lockfile projects. In this stack it is the transitive EC library of web3/ethereumjs-util; the applications' live signing goes through HDWalletProvider and MetaMask. Also declared at kickstart/yarn.lock:1949 (elliptic@6.5.4 — reported as a finding: yarn format not scanned by the collector).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency-inventory component row for selfsigned@2.1.1 (react-scripts chain, lottery-react). Its capability is recorded under ALG-0e533e47; both rows describe the same shipped package from different angles (component vs capability) and are kept as such.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency-inventory entry: hash.js ships SHA-1/SHA-2/RIPEMD-160 in the build (ethereumjs-util chain of the web3 toolchain); also declared at kickstart/yarn.lock:3168 (hash.js@1.1.7 — yarn format not scanned by the collector). No first-party call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency-inventory entry, quantum-safe KDF: the pbkdf2 npm package ships PBKDF2 in the build (crypto-browserify chain in the web3 stack). Facet of the broader PBKDF2 record ALG-4de3b020, which covers the algorithm across all lockfile references; also declared at kickstart/yarn.lock:4693 (yarn format not scanned by the collector).
